about: Volter Editor's Account settings key test for World Labs as it ships (volter-ai/editor b86dde8c5618, packages/editor-core/server/provider-credentials.ts): its own fetch, no World Labs SDK, lists one world with the WLT-Api-Key the World's credential door issues as WORLDLABS_API_KEY. A truncated paste is refused (401) and the editor reports it; the full key connects and the account's list is empty. The readback tests the same key again after the World resumes, the account and its key retained, without issuing another.
